chunks: From him, from Abu Ishaq al-Nahawandi, from al-Barqi, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Whoever spits in the mosque and then swallows it back into his chest, any illness in his chest will be cured by it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of swallowing phlegm after spitting in the mosque according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the act of spitting in the mosque and swallowing the phlegm is presented as a means of curing chest ailments, reflecting the Shia tradition of viewing mosques as places of spiritual and physical healing (barakah). This specific practice underscores the unique sanctity of the mosque, where acts performed with reverence are believed to carry therapeutic benefits, aligning with the broader Islamic emphasis on the purity of sacred spaces.
